jobs.job_title: Senior UI/UX Designer — Hybrid, Brand & Marketing
jobs.job_description:
Ispectra in Saudi Arabia seeks an Associate Design Director, Brand and Marketing to lead integrated campaigns and content across digital and physical touchpoints. You will mentor a multidisciplinary team and translate strategic concepts into compelling brand work.

You bring 3–5 years leading campaigns, production experience in photography, live action and animation, and a portfolio that demonstrates high design taste.
BTranz is hiring a Intermediate UX Designer in Riyadh Saudi Arabia (October 2026). Job DescriptionExperience Requirements:Senior Full Stack Developer: 8–10 Ye

ABOUT CoorB

We build full-fledged innovative solutions with a focus on process automation, user experience enhancement, and advanced data analytics. With our extensive industry expertise, we help achieve operational excellence, future-proof your IT investments, and ensure a competitive edge in the ever-evolving finance industry.
OUR OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Senior UX Designer to work closely with UX/UI Designers, Visual Designers, UX Researchers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Solution Architects, Developers, and banking stakeholders to design intuitive and scalable digital banking experiences. The Senior UX Designer will play a key role in defining the structure, behaviour, and usability of digital banking journeys across retail and corporate banking channels, including mobile and web applications. The role will translate business and customer requirements into clear information architecture, task flows, wireframes, prototypes, UX content, and build-ready functional specifications. The role requires strong experience designing complex digital products within regulated environments, with the ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, technical constraints, accessibility requirements, and banking regulations.
YOU WILL
• Define UX strategy, information architecture, task flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes.
• Design complete journeys covering key states, edge cases, errors, exceptions, and recovery paths.
• Translate research, analytics, and business requirements into clear design decisions.
• Develop UX microcopy, including labels, instructions, errors, confirmations, and notifications.
• Produce functional specifications covering behaviour, business rules, validation, and dependencies.
• Map relevant systems, integrations, hand-offs, and supporting processes.
• Design with Arabic RTL requirements alongside English LTR experiences.
• Apply existing enterprise design-system patterns and identify gaps where new solutions are required.
• Conduct workshops with business, technology, architecture, customer experience, and compliance stakeholders.
• Support benchmarking, expert reviews, analytics analysis, and usability activities.
• Collaborate with visual designers and engineering teams through handover and implementation.
• Review implemented journeys against approved designs and specifications.
• Maintain design documentation and decision records.
• Mentor junior designers and contribute to knowledge transfer.
Requirements
• TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THE ROLE YOU NEED
• 6-10 years of UX design experience, including 3+ years in enterprise, financial services, or regulated environments.
• Strong expertise in information architecture, interaction design, user flows, wireframing, and prototyping.
• Advanced Figma skills and experience working with enterprise design systems.
• Proven ability to translate research and behavioural data into design decisions.
• Experience creating developer-ready functional specifications.
• Good understanding of WCAG 2.2 AA and accessible digital experiences.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
• Excellent written and verbal English.
• Arabic/RTL design experience is an advantage.
• Experience with banking platforms such as Backbase, Temenos, or Finastra is an advantage.
• Banking, fintech, GCC/KSA, or other regulated-industry experience is highly valued.
• Degree or diploma in Design, HCI, or a related field is preferred.

jobs.job_title: Part-Time UX Designer — Riyadh, Creative & Impactful
jobs.job_description:
Jing Hau in Riyadh is seeking a talented UX Designer to join our team. You will design and improve user experiences across our digital platforms, collaborating with product managers, developers, and UI designers.

Responsibilities include user research, creating wireframes, prototypes, and mockups, conducting usability tests, and staying current with industry trends. A strong portfolio and proficiency with Sketch, Adobe XD or Figma are essential; knowledge of HTML/CSS is a plus.

Job Description: Join our partner in Saudi Arabia, a visionary leader crafting innovative technology and AI solutions! We’re recruiting exceptional talent for their on‑site tech team to power transformative projects that redefine the future. If you’re driven by tech and AI, seize this opportunity to thrive in a vibrant, collaborative setting. This is a full‑time onsite opportunity in Saudi Arabia.
Responsibilities
Conduct user interviews, surveys, and usability testing to understand user needs and preferences.
Analyze and interpret research data to inform design decisions.
Design the structure and organization of the AI solution, including navigation and information flow.
Create wireframes and prototypes to illustrate the user interface.
Define and design interactive elements and transitions.
Ensure a seamless and intuitive user experience through thoughtful interaction design.
Plan and conduct usability testing sessions to gather feedback on design prototypes.
Iteratively refine designs based on user testing results.
Work closely with cross‑functional teams, including developers, product owners, and stakeholders.
Collaborate on the implementation of designs and provide support during development.
Create visually appealing and consistent user interfaces based on UX specifications.
Develop style guides and design systems to maintain a cohesive look and feel.
Design icons, graphics, and other visual elements to enhance the aesthetic appeal of the AI solution.
Ensure that the visual design aligns with the overall brand and user expectations.
Design UI elements that are adaptable to various screen sizes and devices.
Collaborate with developers to implement responsive designs.
Develop high‑fidelity prototypes to communicate the visual aspects of the user interface.
Iterate on designs based on feedback and usability testing results.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in UX/UI design, graphic design, HCI, or a related field.
Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in UX/UI design.
Skills: Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Figma, or Adobe XD. Solid understanding of user research, information architecture, and interaction design principles.
Add your Portfolio: Showcase a portfolio of previous design projects, highlighting the design process, problem‑solving skills, and the impact of your designs on user experience.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

About the role

The company Studio is a Saudi AI application designed to transform plain-language business descriptions into functional business systems, such as HR platforms, online stores, and sales boards. Our team in Riyadh is dedicated to enhancing business operations across the Kingdom and beyond.

What you will do

• Design screens and workflows for the company Studio application across iPhone, Android, and web platforms.

• Create templates for business systems developed within the company Studio, accommodating both Arabic (right to left) and English languages.

• Conduct user testing on designs and implement improvements based on feedback.

• Maintain the design system, ensuring colors, typography, and components are in sync with development needs.

• Review designs prior to each release to ensure quality and functionality.

What we need

• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience is required.

• Must be based in Riyadh or willing to relocate.

• A minimum of 3 years of experience in designing mobile and web applications; a portfolio showcasing past work is required.

• Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with designing right-to-left Arabic interfaces.

• Fluency in both Arabic and English, written and spoken.

Pay and terms

• Monthly salary ranges from SAR 14,000 to 20,000 (inclusive of basic salary and allowances), commensurate with experience.

• Full-time position, on-site in our Riyadh office; working hours and annual leave follow Saudi Labour Law regulations.

• Health insurance and GOSI registration provided, in accordance with Saudi law.

How we select

• Applications will receive responses within 7 days.

• Initial 30-minute video call to introduce you to the company Studio.

• For shortlisted candidates, a design exercise lasting 30 minutes will be conducted using the company Studio on our test account (no personal accounts needed).

• Final interview in Riyadh with all candidates informed of their interview results within 30 days.

Applications

Applications are accepted online only through this job posting until 14 January 2027. Each application is evaluated based on skills and experience, and adjustments for candidates with disabilities are available upon request.
